snp4.5:1.1: Paramaṭṭhakasutta. ‘Paraman' ti diṭṭhīsu paribbasāno yad uttariṃkurute jantu loke, "hīnā" ti aññe tato sabba-m-āha: tasmā vivādāni avītivatto. || ||
snp4.5:2.1: Yad attanī passati ānisaṃsaṃ diṭṭhe sute sīlavate mute vā, tad eva so tattha samuggahāya nihīnato passati sabbam aññaṃ. || ||
snp4.5:3.1: Taṃ vāpi ganthaṃ kusalā vadanti, yaṃ nissito passati hīnam aññaṃ, tasmā hi diṭṭhaṃ vā sutaṃ mutaṃ vā sīlabbataṃ bhikkhu na nissayeyya. || ||
snp4.5:4.1: Diṭṭhim pi lokasmiṃ na kappayeyya ñāṇena vā sīlavatena vā pi, ‘samo' ti attānaṃ anūpaneyya ‘hīno' na maññetha ‘visesi' vā pi. || ||
snp4.5:5.1: Attaṃ pahāya anupādiyāno ñāṇe pi so nissayaṃ no karoti, sā ve viyattesu na vaggasārī, diṭṭhim pi so na pacceti kiñci. || ||
snp4.5:6.1: Yassūbhayante paṇidhīdha n' atthi bhavābhavāya idha vā huraṃ vā, nivesanā tassa na santi keci dhammesu niccheyya samugahītā, || || tassīdha
snp4.5:7.1: diṭṭhe va sute mute vā pakappitā n' atthi aṇū pi saññā: taṃ brāhmaṇaṃ diṭṭhim anādiyānaṃ kenīdha lokasmiṃ vikappayeyya. || ||
snp4.5:8.1: Na kappayanti na purekkharonti, dhammā pi tesaṃ na paṭicchitāse,| na brāhmaṇo sīlavatena neyyo, pāraṃgato na pacceti tādi ti || || PARAMAṬṬHAKASUTTAṂ
